content: Hello! how can I help today?
My LLC prepaid 18 months of rent. Can I deduct it all now?
No. Under the **12-month rule** in Reg. §1.263(a)-4(f), only the portion **allocable to the current tax year** is deductible. The rest is amortized over the benefit period.
So what do I do on my return?
Deduct only the portion for months falling within the tax year on **Schedule C or Form 1125-A**, and capitalize the remainder as a prepaid expense.
Is this the same for accrual and cash basis?
The **12-month rule** applies regardless of accounting method. Even cash-basis taxpayers cannot fully deduct prepaid rent beyond 12 months.
Do I need to attach anything?
No, but keep **payment records and lease terms** to substantiate timing if audited. You don’t need to file a separate election—just apply the rule.
